issues.legal_issue: An amendment to a municipal property-tax assessment list cannot impose tax for an official year that had expired before the amendment was made.
material_facts: The municipality had already levied property tax on the company’s properties for several official years.
After detecting new construction and alterations, the municipality resolved to increase the properties’ rateable value for a period that included official years that had already expired.
The assessment-list alteration was made after the end of the period for which the municipality sought the additional tax, and the municipality later issued a demand for that tax.
issues.conclusion: The alteration could not increase the assessment for an official year that had already expired when the alteration was made, and the municipality was not entitled to demand tax for those expired years. The appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Under the scheme of section 123 of the Maharashtra Municipalities Act, the official year is the unit of taxation for municipal property tax. The levy is complete when the assessment list is authenticated, so the relevant amendment and authentication must occur during the official year for which the tax is levied. Section 123(3) is in pari materia with section 82(3) of the Bombay Municipal Boroughs Act, 1925. The Court applied Municipal Corporation of City of Hubli v. Subha Rao Hanumatharao Prayag, which approved the Full Bench decision in Sholapur Municipal Corporation v. Ramchandra Ramappa Madgundi.

predicates.municipal_property_tax_assessment_case: A municipality assessed or sought to levy property tax through an assessment list.
predicates.assessment_amended_after_tax_year: The municipality amended the assessment after the official year for which the amended assessment was intended had ended.
predicates.demand_covers_expired_year: The municipality sought payment of tax for an official year that had ended before the amendment was made.

issues.definition: When a municipality amends a property-tax assessment after the relevant official year has ended and seeks tax for that expired year, the retrospective levy is invalid.
